lead.headline: Iran Strikes Kuwait With 7 Ballistic Missiles — Regional War Widens, Diplomatic Track Contradicted by Kinetic Activity
lead.they_say: Consensus says the diplomatic off-ramp is open. Witkoff and Kushner visited Oak Ridge for nuclear talks. House voted 215-208 to end the war. Trump claims he's 'ready to rock' once the fighting stops. Markets priced a ceasefire that was supposed to materialize any day.
lead.reality: Iran struck Kuwait with 7 ballistic missiles — a major OPEC producer and US ally hit directly. Hormuz remains fully blockaded. Iran flatly denies any uranium transfer deal exists, says nuclear file is postponed. Diplomatic overtures and military action are moving in opposite directions simultaneously. Netanyahu wants to resume the Iran war while Lebanon ceasefire collapses.
lead.thesis: The gap between diplomatic theater and kinetic reality is at its widest in this conflict. Every missile that lands makes the diplomatic track less credible. Oil supply disruption probability is maximal — Kuwait is inside the war zone now.
lead.actors: Iran, Kuwait, US (Trump, Witkoff, Kushner), Israel (Netanyahu), Hezbollah
lead.invalidation_trigger: Iran agrees to uranium framework in verified talks. Hormuz blockade lifted. US announces ceasefire with verified withdrawal zones.
paradigm_implications: Iran-Gulf war is no longer a US-Iran proxy — it's a direct regional war hitting OPEC producers
Israel-Lebanon second front strains US military capacity — Netanyahu wants Iran war resumed while IDF bleeds in Lebanon
lead.capital_flow_implication: Capital floods into oil, gold, defense, and VIX ahead of Sunday open. Out of equities exposed to Gulf supply chains and airlines.
lead.portfolio_implication: Long WTI crude (USO/XLE) — $5-8/bbl gap at Sunday CME open. Long gold (GLD) at $2,415 as geopolitical hedge. Long VIX futures — weekend carry on escalation risk. Short airlines (DAL, UAL) — jet fuel spike + demand destruction. Invalidate if Iran signals verified talks within 24h.

stories.headline: China Launches Maritime Enforcement East of Taiwan — First Time Beijing Names Time, Place, Legal Basis
stories.they_say: Routine traffic enforcement — no different from past Taiwan pressure operations.
stories.reality: Beijing named specific time (June 6), place (east of Taiwan), and legal basis for assertion of control for the first time ever. No vessel boarded yet.
stories.portfolio_implication: Short TSM/SMH at Monday Asia open. Invalidate if no boarding by Tuesday.

stories.headline: Ukraine Hits St. Petersburg With 250+ Drones During PMEF — Military Base + Physics Institute Destroyed
stories.they_say: Putin rejects peace talks, tells army to 'work.' Russian budget deficit at 6.01T rubles, oil/gas revenues down 29.8%.
stories.reality: Ukraine struck Russia's second city during its flagship economic forum — a political humiliation. Naval mine-torpedo base and Fock Physics Institute hit. Strikes may harden Putin's domestic position, perversely prolonging war.
paradigm_implications: Deep-strike capability proven against any Russian city
Ukraine acts more aggressively as US attention diverts to Iran
stories.portfolio_implication: Short Russian assets (RSX). Long defense/nuclear security. Ukrainian war bonds if risk-on.

stories.headline: Bitcoin Free Fall — Saylor Liquidates, ETFs Bleed, 200-Week MA Tested
stories.they_say: Trump says he'll 'never let crypto down.' Senate Clarity Act advances 15-9. Pro-crypto regulation is coming.
stories.reality: BTC drops 5.5% to $61.3K. Strategy sells $2.5M — 'never sell' narrative is dead. $11.5B unrealized loss. ETF outflows at record. 200-week MA at $61K is last line before liquidation cascade.
paradigm_implications: Positive regulation ignored by price — bearish divergence extreme
MSTR leverage unwind creates self-reinforcing downtrend
stories.portfolio_implication: Short BTC on any bounce. Short MSTR. Invalidate if BTC holds $65K for 48h.

stories.headline: Google Signs $920M/Month AI Compute Deal With SpaceX/xAI — IPO Demand Surges
stories.they_say: AI compute demand is insatiable. Google spending $180-190B capex in 2026. SpaceX IPO June 12 is 2x oversubscribed at $75B.
stories.reality: SpaceX lost $4.28B on $4.69B Q1 revenue — losing $0.91 per dollar. $1.8T+ valuation prices in AI revenues that don't exist yet. Broader market risk-off (NASDAQ -4.68%) threatens IPO pop.
paradigm_implications: Hyperscaler capex arms race locks GPU demand for quarters
SpaceX losing money per dollar at $1.8T — pure narrative pricing
stories.portfolio_implication: Buy SPCX at IPO for first-week momentum. Long NVDA. Sell half before Monday close.

stories.headline: Zcash Soundness Bug Researcher Now Audits Monero — XMR Recovers From -10% Panic
stories.they_say: Monero is 'mathematically proven' and more audited than Zcash. The community says a soundness bug is impossible.
stories.reality: Zcash's Orchard pool was also 'battle-tested' before the bug was found. Privacy coins cannot prove absence of bugs. XMR has no transparent fallback — if a bug exists, the coin is unrecoverable.
paradigm_implications: Privacy coins face systemic trust crisis
No privacy coin can prove absence of cryptographic bugs
stories.portfolio_implication: Short XMR on any bounce above $120. Binary event — next researcher update could drop with no warning.
